title: Chad Chops the Ham
lines: Chad and his pal Meg go to the shop.
They pick a ham and a bag of chips.
Chad chops up the ham with Dad.
Dad gets the pan hot and tips the ham in.
Meg and Chad have so much ham and chips.
A bit of ham sits on Chad's chin.
Meg checks the chip bag. It is not full.
Meg sets it on Chad's dish. "You can have it."

questions.ask: Who chops the ham, and who gets the pan hot?
questions.listenFor: Chad chops it with Dad; Dad gets the pan hot. Lines three and four. Two jobs, two people.

questions.ask: How much is left in the chip bag when Meg checks it?
questions.listenFor: One chip. Lines eight and nine say the bag is not full and one chip is in it.

questions.ask: Why do you think Meg gave Chad the last chip?
questions.listenFor: Any kind reason, like he is her pal. Line ten is where she gives it to him.
